indicator_name: Proportion of population satisfied with their last experience of public services
area_27: Quality of institutions is essential to current well-being, equity and inclusiveness, and sustainability. Effective institutions underpin the delivery of public services, the protection of rights and the functioning of markets. They shape whether policies are implemented fairly and whether citizens can trust public systems. Weak institutions are consistently associated with poor economic performance, inequality and instability.
source_organisation_1: Federal Statistical Office (Destatis)
data_footnotes:
The data is based on a special evaluation and is not publicly available.
